articles.summary: Reservoir Media, Inc. (NASDAQ: RSVR), an award-winning independent music company, today announced a new publishing deal with Ivor Novello-winning singer-songwriter Orla Gartland for her future works, including her recent work on the original soundtrack for the fifth season of Apple TV’s “Trying.” This publishing deal expands upon Reservoir’s relationship with Gartland, who has been managed […]
articles.title: RESERVOIR ANNOUNCES PUBLISHING DEAL WITH IVOR NOVELLO-WINNING SINGER-SONGWRITER ORLA GARTLAND
